item.title: Combiner 0.19.0
item.description:
• Drag several files at once: Shift-click picks every row from the selected one to the one you click, Cmd-click adds or drops one, then drag any of them into your DAW and they all come along.
  • Dragging a dropped folder takes every file in it.
  • Space stops whatever is playing.
  • Cold Steel is the default look; the other skins moved under Untested skins in the settings.
